explanation: erdosproblems.com/944: Dirac conjectured (1970) the case r = 1 for all k ≥ 4, i.e. k-vertex-critical graphs with no critical edge. The Lean statement ∀ k ≥ 4, ∃ G with IsErdos944 G k 1 encodes this correctly (every critical edge set has size ≥ 2, equivalently no single critical edge). Note on status: the page (as fetched) still lists k = 4, r = 1 as open, while formal-conjectures tags this `research solved`, relying on the k_eq_four variant's linked Lean formalisation together with Jensen's k ≥ 5 result. The statement itself is faithful.
